Package frc.spectrumLib.util

Class Curve

java.lang.Object
frc.spectrumLib.util.Curve
Direct Known Subclasses:
ExpCurve
public abstract class Curve extends Object
Maps controller stick inputs through a curve. Subclass this rather than instantiating Curve directly, for example ExpCurve.
